newsitem.title: USA: Michael Jackson's wife gives birth in LA.
newsitem.headline: Michael Jackson's wife gives birth in LA.

text.p: Pop singer Michael Jackson's wife gave birth Wednesday to a baby boy, a Los Angeles television station reported.
KNBC said Debbie Rowe, 37, who married Jackson last November, told the station she had been induced earlier in the day and gave birth in the afternoon.

KNBC anchor Chuck Henry said: "Debbie Rowe called us just literally two minutes before we went on the air this afternoon to tell us 'yes indeed' she had a little baby, a baby boy. I asked her how the child was doing and she said 'he's doing fine and she's doing fine.'"
Security was tight and a spokeswoman for Cedars-Sinai Medical Center declined any comment. There was no immediate confirmation either from Jackson's publicists.
Recent reports said Rowe, who married Jackson in Australia less than a year after his divorce from Lisa Marie Presley, would give birth at a clinic in Switzerland.
The couple have known each other for several years, as Rowe had worked in the Beverly Hills office of Jackson's dermatologist.
